DML.SELECT: SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_subtype_id as "elementSubtypeId", element_id as "id", location_id as "locationId", keep_values_on_disconnected as "keepValuesOnDisconnected", inherit_state_id as "inheritStateId", alias as "alias", description as "description", on_change_alarm as "onChangeAlarm", on_change_state as "onChangeState", on_change_measure as "onChangeMeasure", on_schedule as "onSchedule", measure_change_all as "measureChangeAll", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.elements (element_type_id, element_subtype_id, element_id, location_id, keep_values_on_disconnected, inherit_state_id, alias, description, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId, :elementSubtypeId, :id=getNextId{'conf.elements'$'element_id'$'element_type_id=elementTypeId'}, :locationId, :keepValuesOnDisconnected, :inheritStateId, :alias, :description, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.elements SET location_id = :locationId, keep_values_on_disconnected = :keepValuesOnDisconnected, inherit_state_id = :inheritStateId, alias = :alias, description = :description, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :id
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.elements WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :id
